meta.title: GRN Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Warehouse Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and as a Warehouse Manager
Open and configure the GRN Approval Workflow to require approval by value or quantity threshold
Assert that the non-Warehouse Manager is refused or does not receive the workflow action while the Warehouse Manager can perform it
Verify or select the tenant's Enterprise plan and record any tenant RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and as a Warehouse Manager; Open and configure the GRN Approval Workflow to require approval by value or quantity threshold; Assert that the non-Warehouse Manager is refused or does not receive the workflow action while the Warehouse Manager can perform it; Verify or select the tenant's Enterprise plan and record any tenant RBAC configuration

args.need: sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and as a Warehouse Manager, open the GRN Approval Workflow, configure a value or quantity threshold, attempt the approval action with both users, and record whether the first user is refused or lacks the action while the Warehouse Manager can perform it

steps.note: The catalog cannot access GRN Approval Workflow or authenticate as users with different roles.
Assert that the resulting screen has no visible application error or crash after the tester's comparison.
